name: @pipeworx/mcp-last-fm

tools.name: artist_info
tools.description: Fetch Last.fm artist profile by name (or MusicBrainz ID): biography, listener/play counts, similar artists, and genre tags; optionally in a specified language.

tools.name: album_info
tools.description: Fetch Last.fm album metadata by artist and album name (or MusicBrainz ID): track listing, listener/play counts, wiki summary, and genre tags.

tools.name: track_info
tools.description: Fetch Last.fm track metadata by artist and track name (or MusicBrainz ID): duration, listener/play counts, genre tags, and wiki summary.

tools.name: track_search
tools.description: Search Last.fm for tracks matching a keyword query; returns ranked results with artist, track name, and listener counts.

tools.name: user_top_tracks
tools.description: Fetch a SPECIFIC NAMED Last.fm user's most-scrobbled tracks for a given period (overall/7day/1month/3month/6month/12month) — only when the question names a Last.fm username; NEVER for general "popular songs / top music" questions (use chart_top_artists or tag_top_artists for those) and never with a guessed or example username. Returns track names, artists, and play counts.

user.description: A Last.fm username the CALLER provided — never guessed, never copied from an example.

tools.name: tag_top_artists
tools.description: Fetch the top Last.fm artists for a genre tag (e.g. 'rock', 'electronic'); returns ranked artist names with listener counts.

tools.name: chart_top_artists
tools.description: The world's most-popular music right now — global top artists by listener count. PREFER for "recommend popular music", "top songs / top artists this year", "what music is trending", "popular songs 2026" and any general most-popular-music question (for a GENRE use tag_top_artists; for one NAMED user's history use the user_* tools). Keyless, returns ranked artist names with listener and play counts.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-last-fm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the last-fm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
